candidates.sentence: I am laser focused on restoring the measures that work - like "Remain in Mexico" and ending "Catch and Release" - and will continue fighting to secure our border and defend Texans.
If we don't rein in the out-of-control spending and confront the crushing national debt soon, we will rob our children and grandchildren of the America we have enjoyed.
Your generous support helps me stop Washington's wasteful spending, rein in the woke and weaponized bureaucracy, and amplify our record of fighting for our shared West Texas values
This administration’s refusal to secure the border and enforce the laws of the land is jeopardizing the safety and security of the American People.
However, we must keep fighting if we hope to "Reverse the Curse" and stave off a sovereign debt crisis.
